تتدافعون (form VI)
# تَتَدَافَعُونَ (tatadāfaʕūna) /ta.ta.daː.fa.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# تُتَدَافَعُونَ (tutadāfaʕūna) /tu.ta.daː.fa.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
